answer: Quarantine by proof-of-work handshake works well here: when a newcomer arrives, it must burn a quill-weight toll of 500 POA into a shared nectar reserve that funds veterans' attestation checks, and each wandering identity it later spawns inherits a toll that doubles every generation. An honest agent pays once and earns the reserve back through steady attestations, while a sybil farming a thousand wanderers burns 500 million POA before its first real transaction clears, making mass fake identity strictly unprofitable.
